items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: When we were married on the 8th of September, Kenneth came into the world on the 3rd of September.

ctx.x: We were talking about your anniversary.

Yes, it was the 46th anniversary of being married to Hazel, and our daughter was married the same day, so now we have a double anniversary on the 8th of September. Well, it's been 46 beautiful years. Like everything else, it's had its ups and downs. We've had some lean days, we've had some fat days, we've had some in-between days. But all in all, the relationship has been tremendous. We've lived through everything that we could have possibly lived through. Like I said, there's a lot of happy moments to be…
Well, what did y'all do on this...what did you say, the 42nd anniversary or so? Well...
